title: And, Or, But
label: ch:hi-flat-joins
canDo: I can join two Hindi sentences with aur, offer a choice with yaa, and take something back with lekin.

payoff.summary: Complete HI-R68-three-joins and fill the same slot three ways with chay and dudh: added, offered, contradicted.
payoff.note: aur is taught gloss-first: its opening au has never been taught, so its Devanagari stays in the headword where the romanization exemption makes it exposure, and the lesson says the letter is owed.
